summary: Sync must send the list params Hostex enforces even though the spec marks them optional: an explicit offset on the first page and a date window of at most 366 days on /transactions.
reason: Hostex rejects /conversations without offset and /transactions without start_date/end_date (range capped at 366 days, so sync covers the last 365 days), and a default sync of automation and pricing-ratios always 400s. Reviews have no id field, so they are keyed by reservation_code.
validated_outcome: Live read-only sync on a clean database on the 4.33.0 reprint: 23/23 resources, 222 records; TestSyncSendsParamsHostexRequires covers the explicit offset and the 365-day transactions window.
